# GDPR — articles and recitals

<!-- generated by _system/build.py from _sources/ — do not edit; rerun the script -->

Regulation (EU) 2016/679 as published in the Official Journal on 4 May 2016, one file per article or recital, word for word. Later corrections are not included.

Path of any article: `gdpr/<chapter folder>/art-NNN.md`, three digits. Sizes are in tokens. Each file ends with links to what it cites, what cites it, and the review areas that use it. Defined terms: `_index/definitions.md`.

## Recitals · `recitals/`

Recitals 1–173, one file each: `recitals/rec-NNN.md`. They explain the articles but don't bind on their own. The list with each recital's opening words is in [recitals/CONTEXT.md](recitals/CONTEXT.md).

Also here: `_front.md` (title page) and `_footnotes.md` (Official Journal references).
